headline: Nigeria's USD 2.5 Billion Power Privatisation Fails to Deliver Reliable Electricity
summary: Thirteen years after handing electricity distribution and generation assets to private investors in a USD 2.5 billion privatization program, Nigeria continues to struggle with delivering reliable power supply.
why: Reliable electricity infrastructure is a foundational requirement for industrial productivity and economic growth in developing markets.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Inadequate power supply constrains broader industrial growth.
